title: fix-tests outcome
description: The outcome of a fix-tests session (feature-fix-tests.md), its final message (F-68 D2). fixed: the loop reruns the gate. rerun: the loop reruns the gate once, and a failure goes to one more session. unrelated: the loop escalates with the reason, unless the reason sounds flaky (looksFlaky), which sends the session back once. reason is required for every outcome, so Codex's strict --output-schema has no optional field to refuse.

summary.description: One line: what the session did.

outcome.description: fixed: a fix is committed. rerun: the failure would not reproduce after a real attempt. unrelated: nothing in the repos can make the gate pass.

reason.description: fixed: the cause you fixed. rerun: what you tried. unrelated: why nothing in the repos can make the gate pass.
